items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: The personnel on these recordings were Mr. Blakeney, trumpet; ... alto saxophone, Leo Davis; ... C.L. Burk.

ctx.x: and even a private residence if he thought that booze was being sold.

1944 and 1945. Mr. Blakeney recorded with the C.L. Burk Orchestra in Los Angeles. He recalls recording four sides. The label he is not sure of but the company was possibly owned by Leon Rene. The personnel on these recordings were Mr. Blakeney, trumpet; George Orendorf, trumpet Jake Porter, trumpet;trombone, possibly Vic Dickenson; alto saxophone, Leo Davis; tenor and arranger, Maxwell Davis. Also tenor, Bumps Myers; piano, Charlie Lawrence; bass, Red Calendar; drummer unknown; guitar and leader, also vocalist,…
Mr. Blakeney states that these records were very popular during 1944 and 1945 and could be heard on many of the local jukeboxes.
